source: County of Los Angeles, Internal Services Department (eGIS). 2026. Countywide Statistical Areas (CSA), layer 23 'Community Boundaries (CSA)' of LACounty_Dynamic/Political_Boundaries [dataset]. County of Los Angeles Enterprise GIS Repository. Accessed November 7, 2026. https://public.gis.lacounty.gov/public/rest/services/LACounty_Dynamic/Political_Boundaries/MapServer/23. 374 features: the City of Los Angeles by its communities (Hollywood, Koreatown, Downtown, Silver Lake...), the other 87 cities whole (West Hollywood, Santa Monica, Long Beach, Pasadena...), and the unincorporated communities (East Los Angeles, Marina del Rey...); pier, breakwater and water parts folded into their city or community; spellings fixed (Silverlake -> Silver Lake, Mid-city -> Mid-City, Mt. Washington -> Mount Washington, Playa Del Rey -> Playa del Rey); simplified to about 30 m (D-1160).
